items.description: Antongil Bay was a site of historical Dutch settlement attempts in the 17th century, highlighting early European maritime interest in Madagascar's strategic location.
Antongona consists of ancient stone fortifications built by the Merina kings, serving as a defensive structure in the central highlands to protect royal interests.
Analamazaotra served as a colonial station during the era of French administration, acting as a center for infrastructure management and resource exploitation.
Toliara grew as an important administrative and trading center during the French colonial period, connecting the southwest with international maritime routes.
Diego Suarez (Antsiranana) and the surrounding Cape region have a long history as a strategic naval base, utilized by colonial powers for its natural harbor.
Nosy Boraha, formerly known as Île Sainte-Marie, contains historical fortifications that protected the island against pirates and rival colonial powers.
